newsitem.title: CANADA: CAW members approve Canadian Air plan.
newsitem.headline: CAW members approve Canadian Air plan.

text.p: Canadian Auto Workers union members at Canadian Airlines Corp voted 81 percent in favor of a wage-cut deal negotiated with the company and Canadian government earlier this month, the union said on Friday.
CAW workers at Canadian unit Canadian Regional voted 86 percent in favor of the deal, which includes wage cuts for all employees that average under four percent, it said.

Local president Anne Davidson repeated the union's position that a thorough examination of what the union describes as "destructive competition and predatory pricing" in the Canadian airline industry was necessary.
Canadian said the hard fought and much-publicized agreement, part of an effort to bring C$180 million per year to its bottom line, was necessary to avoid financial failure in the first part of 1997.
